MENTOR: Good, Tile, Caption and Stamp it is. That's the comp at 0 s. The preview came back too small for me to make out where the three layers sit, so I won't describe it.

Here's the idea. When a layer has a **parent**, it follows the parent's position, scale and rotation, and it still runs its own animation on top. A **null** is an invisible layer you use only as a handle. You put it where the group should turn or scale from, make Tile, Caption and Stamp follow it, and then animate just the null. You already have one in this comp: Hatch follows Hatch Rig.

Two things to keep in mind:
- Children follow position, scale and rotation, but **not opacity or effects**. Fading the null does nothing you can see.
- A null **never shows up in the render**, so it doesn't add anything to how the group looks.

Your turn. Add a null with **Layer > New > Null Object**. Then tell me: **where should this group turn or scale from?** It could be a corner, the middle of an edge, or the middle of the group. "It'll only slide" is a fine answer too.

### Turn 3: the project is an open comp
LEARNER: I added a null and put it on the group's top-left corner, since the group turns from there. Done.

Next, make Tile, Caption and Stamp follow Null 1. Use the **Parent & Link column** in the timeline. If it isn't showing, right-click any column heading and choose **Columns > Parent & Link**. MENTOR: All three now follow Null 1, but a couple of things are off:

- **They jumped.** Tile, Caption and Stamp are each 132 px up and to the left of where they were at 0 s. Use Edit > Undo and parent them again. A null that moved after you placed it can also cause this.
